svg.title: KurtShape concept mockup: Sketch editing · restrained polish
svg.desc: Concept mockup, not a screenshot. Native Sketcher stays the editor; KurtShape's box becomes the single status/acceptance surface and the Tasks dock is hidden by default.

g.text: End of history · drag to roll back
Bold = target for new features · right-click to change
Circle radius and its position along X are free
Finish Enter · Cancel Esc · N normal · Shift+7 iso
Later features are hidden while you edit this sketch
mm · L line · G rectangle · C circle · D dimension · Esc ends tool
CONCEPT MOCKUP · not a screenshot of implemented behavior
Native Sketcher stays the editor; KurtShape's box becomes the single status/acceptance surface and the Tasks dock is hidden by default.
One sketch box, one check/cross pair (the toolbar pair at the row end is the same actions): no Normal/Isometric buttons inside, no third native 'Close'.
Solver verdict is a wrapped, colored status line with the DoF count and a plain-language cause; never elided (QLabel word-wrap + tooltip, fed from
Native Tasks panel hidden by default behind 'Native panel ▸'; constraints/elements counts summarised instead. Viewport gains ~30% width.
Dimension text drawn upright with a white halo (Sketcher 'dimension text rotation'/font settings; verify in the pinned build, see B findings).
Later features rolled back and shown muted/italic while editing an earlier sketch, with the box saying so.
Status bar left chip says 'Editing sketch'; hints move to the centre zone and are elided with a tooltip, never truncated mid-word.
